subject: Recap + pilot playbook: alignment & next steps for Northstar Systems
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Cho <emily.cho@northstar.com>, Mike Tran <mike.tran@northstar.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-02T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + pilot playbook: alignment & next steps for Northstar Systems

Thanks for your time today — quick recap and proposed playbook to get the pilot started this month. High level: we heard three core priorities from Northstar on the call and proposed a focused 6-week pilot to validate throughput, cost, and accuracy on your MRP workflows.

Pain points you shared
- Slow batch inference for nightly MRP runs (latency spikes at ~3am) causing delayed downstream reports
- Tokenized forecast prompts produce inconsistent predictions for short-horizon SKUs
- Need clear auditability and data residency controls for vendor compliance

Goals we aligned on
- Bring end-to-end inference latency for core MRP job below 450ms per request at peak
- Demonstrate 20% reduction in per-request token cost with caching/batching profiles
- Produce reproducible prompt/eval suite to measure SKU-level forecast accuracy

Proposed pilot scope (6 weeks)
1) Week 0–1: Access + data handoff — sample data ingestion (you mentioned CSV export from MRP). Request: sanitized sample (<=10k rows) and SFTP credentials or temporary signed URL.
2) Week 1–3: Model selection & runtime tuning — run model variants, quantization candidates, and throughput tuning in Redwood dev cluster.
3) Week 3–5: Prompt set & evals — joint prompt suite (we'll seed 50 SKU-level prompts), automated regression checks, and quality thresholds.
4) Week 5–6: Acceptance & handoff — performance report, cost runbook, and canary plan for production rollout.

Owners (initial)
- Northstar: Emily (product) + Mike (infra) for data access and success criteria sign-off
- Redwood: Rishi (AE, deal owner) + Grace (CS, pilot ops) + me (technical lead / coordination)

Requested next steps (can we confirm by EOD Wednesday?)
- Emily/Mike: share sanitized sample dataset or an SFTP/Drive link
- Emily: confirm the primary SKUs/time window (e.g., last 90 days) for evaluation
- Rishi/Grace: schedule kickoff working session (30–45m) next week — suggested windows Wed/Thu 9–11 PT

Attachments: draft playbook PDF and sample ingestion template attached (see below).

Thanks again — I’ll stand up a HubSpot deal record and a shared Drive folder after we confirm access.

—
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood-poc-playbook-v1.pdf (18KB, PDF), northstar_mrp_sample_data.csv (stub, CSV)
From: Emily Cho <emily.cho@northstar.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike Tran <mike.tran@northstar.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-02T17:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + pilot playbook: alignment & next steps for Northstar Systems

Thanks Jordan — great summary and thanks everyone for joining. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Data: we can export a sanitized CSV of the MRP runs (we'll remove PII). I will ask infra to generate a temporary signed S3 URL and send by EOD Thursday.
- SKUs/time window: start with our core 1,200 SKUs and 90-day history. If size is an issue, we'll sample by top 400 SKUs by volume.
- Access: Mike will own the S3 link and temp credentials. He may loop in our security lead if you need an NDA addendum for dev cluster access.

One ask: we need a short list of acceptance criteria we can sign off on before the pilot starts (latency target, cost delta, minimal accuracy threshold). Can you draft those as part of the playbook?

We'll confirm the kickoff time tomorrow — leaning to Thu 9:30 PT.

Best,
Emily
Emily Cho
Director, Product — Supply Planning | Northstar Systems
emily.cho@northstar.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Cho <emily.cho@northstar.com>, Mike Tran <mike.tran@northstar.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-03T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + pilot playbook: alignment & next steps for Northstar Systems

Perfect — thanks Emily. We'll include a concise acceptance criteria table in the playbook PDF and highlight the sign-off points. Draft acceptance criteria (we can adjust):
- Latency: median request latency < 300ms; 95th percentile < 450ms for the nightly MRP job at pilot traffic
- Cost: >= 15% reduction in per-request token spend compared to your current baseline (with recommended caching/batching)
- Quality: SKU-level forecast RMSE reduction target of >= 5% vs baseline (or no more than 3% degradation in top-10 SKUs)
- Security: proof-of-concept audit log capture + confirmation of data residency controls for test data

I'll attach an updated playbook with that criteria and propose Thu 2026-08-05 09:30 PT for kickoff (30m). Rishi — can you confirm availability and I'll send the calendar invite. Grace — if you can lead the pilot ops call and own the runbook, that would be great.

—
Jordan
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Cho <emily.cho@northstar.com>, Mike Tran <mike.tran@northstar.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + pilot playbook: alignment & next steps for Northstar Systems

Thanks — I'll take pilot ops ownership. Follow-up items from me: 

1) Internal prep: I'll provision a temporary Redwood dev workspace and pre-seed it with the playbook templates. Expect an invite to the shared Drive (linked below).
2) Data checklist for Northstar (Emily/Mike) — please confirm: sanitized CSV, sample schema (column list), expected daily volume, and any fields to redact. If you prefer SFTP we can accept that too.
3) Quick intake form: please fill this doc with contact and security POC info before Thu kickoff: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-redwood-northstar-playbook

I confirmed Thu 2026-08-05 09:30 PT on my calendar. Rishi — will you send the invite and include a 15-min tech precall for Grace/Rishi/Jordan at 9:00 PT?

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: redwood-poc-playbook-v1.pdf (updated w/ acceptance criteria)
